what_happened: Layout 9, yellow Straw009, GlassCup022. Stage 0: closed on the handle at 167 and pulled the drawer to 1.04 by 208 (complete 205, median). Stage 1: drawer bumped further open 274-288 (1.50), straw grasped 355-368 (width 0.0135) and lifted 0.58 m, navigation 371-588. 700-743 the straw was held vertically directly over the cup, lowered in and released at 743 (centre 3.4 cm from the cup centre); it stayed standing/leaning in the cup and the gripper backed off. Success at 765 (stage 1 took 560 steps).
self_recovery: No error to recover from; the time at the cup before release was ~40 steps.
official_criterion_notes: Straw tilt fields are relative to the straw lying flat: 'tipped_over' (>45 deg) here means the straw was held or standing vertical, not that it fell over. tipped_over 598-768 = straw vertical.
